Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and
restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the collision.
Over the course of ten visits, care included passive and active range-of-motion exercises, progressive strengthening,
and manual therapy. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, reflecting a slower
funtcional recovery. On examination, pain with resisted abduction and a reduced arc of motion support the diagnosis
of a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, while neurovascular screening and several orthopedic special tests were within
noraml limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to this body region, and no earlier records addressing
the shoulder were available for review. Billing records reflect a single charge for each service rendered, with no
duplicate entries. At the most recent visit, the patient demonstrated improved strength and motion but had not yet
returned fully to prior activity levels. Continued home exercise and periodic reassessment are recommended.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
